in_arabic.name: تبليغون
in_arabic.meaning: الدعوة إلى الله تعالى والإبلاغ عن رسالته
in_arabic.long_meaning: تبليغون هو اسم مشتق من الفعل 'تبليغ' الذي يعني الإبلاغ أو التبليغ. في السياق الإسلامي، يعني الاسم نشر الرسالة الإلهية والدعوة إلى الله تعالى. يرتبط هذا الاسم بفكرة الإبلاغ عن رسالة الإسلام ونشرها بين الناس، مما يعكس قيمة مهمة في الإسلام وهي دعوة الناس إلى الله بالحكمة والموعظة الحسنة.

in_urdu.name: تبلیغون
in_urdu.meaning: اللہ تعالی کی دعوت اور اس کی رسالت کا اعلان
in_urdu.long_meaning: تبلیغون ایک نام ہے جو 'تبلیغ' فعل سے ماخوذ ہے، جس کا مطلب ہے اعلان یا تبلیغ کرنا۔ اسلامی 맥ام میں، اس نام کا مطلب ہے الہی رسالت کا نشر کرنا اور اللہ تعالی کی دعوت دینا۔ یہ نام اسلامی عقیدے کے ایک اہم پہلو کو ظاہر کرتا ہے، جو لوگوں کو اللہ کی طرف دعوت دینا ہے۔

in_hindi.name: तबलीग़ुन
in_hindi.meaning: भगवान की बुलावा और उसके संदेश का एलान
in_hindi.long_meaning: तबलीग़ुन 'तबलीग़' क्रिया से लिया गया एक नाम है, जिसका अर्थ है घोषणा करना या प्रचार करना। इस्लामी संदर्भ में, यह नाम दिव्य संदेश को फैलाने और भगवान की बुलावा को आमंत्रित करने के लिए है। यह इस्लामी विश्वास के एक महत्वपूर्ण पहलू को दर्शाता है, जो लोगों को भगवान की ओर बुलाने के लिए प्रोत्साहित करता है।

in_pashto.name: تبليغون
in_pashto.meaning: الله تعالی ته د بلنې او د هغه پیغام اعلان
in_pashto.long_meaning: تبليغون د 'تبليغ' فعل څخه اخستل شوی نوم دی، چې معنی یې اعلان کول یا تبليغ کول دي. په اسلامي سياق کې، دا نوم د الهي پيغام خپرول او الله تعالی ته د بلنې ورکول معنی لري. دا د اسلامي عقيدې يو مهم اړخ ښيي، کوم چې د خلکو د الله تعالی طرف ته د بلنې لپاره تشويق کوي.

in_english.name: Tablighun
in_english.meaning: Call to Allah, propagation of His message
in_english.long_meaning: Tablighun is derived from the Arabic root 'tabligh,' which means to convey or propagate. In Islamic context, the name signifies the act of calling people to Allah and spreading His divine message. It embodies a fundamental aspect of Islamic faith, emphasizing the importance of inviting others to the path of righteousness. The name Tablighun reflects the values of da'wa (calling others to Islam) and tabligh (spreading the message), which are highly esteemed in Islamic tradition.

data.cultural_impact: The term "Tablighi Jamaat" itself translates to "Society for the Propagation of the Faith". This organization was founded in India during the late 1800s and has since grown to become a global movement encouraging Muslims to moral and spiritual improvement, and inspired to share their beliefs and practices with others. The Tablighi Jamaat movement has had a significant cultural impact, especially in Southeast Asia and South Asia, promoting unity among Muslims and encouraging interfaith dialogue and relations.
data.spiritual_significance: For practicing Muslims, the idea of being a "Tablighi" carries a deep spiritual significance. Propagating the message of God and helping others grow spiritually are seen as essential acts of faith and obedience to Allah. In Islamic tradition, this endeavor to spread the message of faith to others is a form of religious service and differentiates the believer from the disbeliever. Additionally, it is a means of personal growth and self-reflection, pushing the individual to continually strive for a better understanding and connection with their Creator.

modern_usage.modern_context: The Islamic movement Tablighi Jamaat (TJ), known for its intensive missionary activities, has adapted to modern times through various platforms. These platforms include: Tablighi Jamaat Conferences, Tablighi Jamaat Digital, and Tablighi Jamaat Interfaith. TJ Conferences continue to attract large crowds for short-term spiritual retreats, while Tablighi Jamaat Digital utilizes social media and technology to spread the message of TJ beyond traditional borders. Interfaith initiatives allow TJ to engage in dialogue with other religious communities, promoting peaceful coexistence and understanding.
